exports: pub fn accept_frame(state: &mut FragmentState, frame: IncomingFrame, policy: &WssPolicy) -> Result<ReceiveEvent>

test_vectors.vectors: Each required frame, message, fragment, syntax payload, and depth limit set to zero; unrelated syntax limits set to zero; frame ceiling above message ceiling.
test_vectors.expected: ConstraintViolation from Transport for required zero limits; valid independent nonzero ceilings accepted; policy errors clear partial assembly.

test_vectors.vectors: Text and Binary final frames using Shared, Bytes, and sliced Bytes owners; application buffers and cloned inputs dropped; empty and non-JSON UTF-8 data.
test_vectors.expected: Allowed data preserves its original owner and pointer; BinaryPolicy::Reject rejects both final and nonfinal Binary with TypeMismatch; transport acceptance does not issue a JSON proof.

test_vectors.vectors: Each byte ceiling independently tightened to four bytes with three-, four-, and five-byte messages; two-byte frames assembled into a four-byte message; continuation frame and accumulated message ceilings tightened separately.
test_vectors.expected: Inclusive frame, transport message, and syntax payload boundaries; oversized data returns PayloadTooLarge and discards assembly; assembled messages may exceed the per-frame ceiling.

test_vectors.vectors: One through three fragment ceilings with empty initial and continuation frames; exact final fragment boundary; u32::MAX count increment; usize addition overflow; ABI u32 length overflow on 64-bit targets.
test_vectors.expected: Initial and final frames count even when empty; count exhaustion and overflow return BudgetExhausted; byte arithmetic and ABI overflow return PayloadTooLarge without large allocations.

test_vectors.vectors: Reserve usize::MAX additional bytes in a nonempty vector, then append normal and empty slices.
test_vectors.expected: Deterministic capacity overflow returns BudgetExhausted without changing contents, pointer, or capacity; subsequent bounded appends succeed. This exercises allocation-error mapping without inducing host out-of-memory.

test_vectors.vectors: Orphan final and nonfinal Continuation; Text and Binary arriving during active assembly; successful fresh data after ordering errors.
test_vectors.expected: FramingError from Transport; active assembly cleared with capacity retained; open state can accept a new message.

test_vectors.vectors: Every byte split of quoted two-, three-, and four-byte Unicode scalars for Text and BinaryPolicy::Json; a four-byte scalar delivered as four one-byte fragments.
test_vectors.expected: Pending until final continuation, then complete original UTF-8 bytes with the initial data opcode and owned accumulated storage.

test_vectors.vectors: Invalid lead and continuation bytes, overlong encoding, surrogate encoding, out-of-range scalar, truncated scalar, and invalid byte after valid Unicode; both data opcodes and direct versus fragmented input.
test_vectors.expected: InvalidUtf8 from Utf8 at the first invalid sequence offset only on message completion; assembly discarded; byte errors take precedence over UTF-8 processing.

test_vectors.vectors: Opaque invalid-UTF-8 payloads of zero, one, 124, and 125 bytes, both payload storage variants, interleaved with active data at a tight fragment and JSON byte budget.
test_vectors.expected: Control events preserve payload owners and pointers, accept opaque bytes independently of JSON ceilings, and leave all active assembly fields and storage unchanged.

test_vectors.vectors: Nonfinal Ping, Pong, and Close; 126-byte controls; controls exceeding a separately tightened two-byte frame ceiling.
test_vectors.expected: FramingError for nonfinal controls, PayloadTooLarge for byte ceilings, and assembly reset without closing an open state.

test_vectors.vectors: All 65,536 u16 codes encoded big endian; empty payload; one-byte payload.
test_vectors.expected: Only 1000..=1003, 1007..=1014, and 3000..=4999 accepted; empty payload returns no status and empty reason; malformed or reserved status returns FramingError.

test_vectors.vectors: Empty, ASCII, Unicode, NUL, newline, and non-JSON reasons; zero through 123 reason bytes; 41 three-byte scalars reaching 123 bytes; one excess byte; malformed and truncated UTF-8 reasons.
test_vectors.expected: Borrowed UTF-8 reason excludes status bytes; 123-byte ceiling inclusive; overlong close payload returns PayloadTooLarge; InvalidUtf8 offsets include the two-byte close status prefix.

test_vectors.vectors: Empty and status-bearing Close during active assembly with Shared and Bytes payloads; sliced Bytes close owner dropped; every opcode and finality after successful close; invalid policy after close; malformed close followed by fresh data.
test_vectors.expected: Close reason owns only its exposed reason range; Bytes shares its reason view; successful Close discards assembly and preserves closed across resets; every subsequent frame returns FramingError; malformed close clears assembly while leaving the connection open.

test_vectors.vectors: Tightened active Binary policy, fragment ceiling, transport message ceiling, and syntax payload ceiling; UTF-8 diagnostic base offset at u32::MAX.
test_vectors.expected: Continuations obey current policy; failures clear assembly; diagnostic offset addition cannot wrap.
